title: SentinelVerdict
description: The only accepted output of the Watchtower Sentinel subagent. Anything else is a malformed answer (retried once, then the hold resolves to refuse). The verdict may resolve a held package only; it can never override a hard refusal signal.

investigation.description: The investigation id from the task prompt, echoed back so the verdict can be matched to its package even when the host reports no agent id.
